obernants.operator: For real convex quadratic minimization on C, exclude infeasible x or b-Q*x outside N_C(x); for Lasso exclude Aᵀ(A*x-y)+lambda*s!=0 for every s in the L1 subgradient. For a supplied scalar restriction, exclude an Armijo step violating its sufficient-decrease inequality and a claimed global Brent minimizer outside the stipulated unimodal target. Native finite reports instead obey rounded transition/stopping relations: box projected-step residual, simplex FW gap and Lasso KKT residual are distinct. Exclude switching the minus-linear convention, using objective error as coordinate error, exceeding callback budget or relabeling exhausted/stagnated reports. Native Converged does not assert the exact real KKT equalities.

obernants.operator: For fixed real Q,C and feasible optimizer x, compatible linear terms lie in Q*x+N_C(x); thus a boundary optimizer generally does not identify b. Identity-design Lasso with lambda fixed gives y_i=x_i+lambda*sign(x_i) for nonzero x_i, while x_i=0 admits every y_i in [-lambda,lambda]. General designs admit y with Aᵀ(y-A*x) in lambda*partial||x||1, including null(Aᵀ) perturbations. Brent and Armijo observations retain many callbacks agreeing at the sampled points but differing elsewhere; a step does not recover its direction or original objective. These are real target fibers; matching a native report additionally requires matching its rounded path, validation and status.
